title: GL-14 — RDS single-AZ
stopChargesPanel: Delete the DB instance without a final snapshot, wait until it is deleted, then delete the DB subnet group. This lab uses the default VPC security group. RDS forgotten overnight is costly.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on RDS PostgreSQL; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Accept cost risk
bullets: In the lab card, open the cost-risk box and type `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` exactly as shown.
Success: the UI records your confirmation before any hourly resource is created.
Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.

steps.title: Create DB subnet group
bullets: Run `$VpcId = aws ec2 describe-vpcs --filters Name=isDefault,Values=true --query "Vpcs[0].VpcId" --output text`.
Run `$SubnetIds = (aws ec2 describe-subnets --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=$VpcId --query "Subnets[0:2].SubnetId" --output text) -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ }`.
Run `$SubnetGroup = "workbook-gl14"`.
Run `aws rds create-db-subnet-group --db-subnet-group-name $SubnetGroup --db-subnet-group-description gl14 --subnet-ids $SubnetIds --tags Key=LabId,Value=gl-14 Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab`.
Success: subnet group exists.

steps.title: Create single-AZ instance
bullets: Run `$DbId = "workbookgl14"`.

Run `aws rds create-db-instance --db-instance-identifier $DbId --db-instance-class db.t3.micro --engine postgres --master-username labadmin --master-user-password 'TempGl14Pass!' --allocated-storage 20 --backup-retention-period 1 --no-multi-az --no-publicly-accessible --db-subnet-group-name $SubnetGroup --tags Key=LabId,Value=gl-14 Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab`.
Run `aws rds wait db-instance-available --db-instance-identifier $DbId`.
Success: DBInstanceStatus is available.

steps.title: Describe instance
bullets: Run `aws rds describe-db-instances --db-instance-identifier $DbId`.
Success: endpoint and class match your choices.

steps.title: Delete without final snapshot
bullets: Run `aws rds delete-db-instance --db-instance-identifier $DbId --skip-final-snapshot`.
Run `aws rds wait db-instance-deleted --db-instance-identifier $DbId`.
Success: instance is deleted.

steps.title: Delete subnet group
bullets: Run `aws rds delete-db-subnet-group --db-subnet-group-name $SubnetGroup`.
Success: subnet group is gone.

steps.title: Forgotten RDS risk
bullets: An RDS instance left running overnight is the main cost risk in this module.
Success: you deleted the instance in this session.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Confirm you typed `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` in the card before any hourly create.
Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Stopping an instance or scaling to zero is not teardown.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: RDS instance (wait until deleted), subnet group. If s09 already deleted the instance, delete-db-instance reports DBInstanceNotFound and the wait returns at once
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-14` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-14 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-14 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-14. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: Smallest single-AZ PostgreSQL briefly, then delete without final snapshot same day.
